rationale: This is a mechanical splice of two already-archived signals — "Cash-Backed Profit Floor" (che-yield × TS_MIN post-depreciation ROA) and "Cash-Burn-Protected Balance Value" (che-yield × MIN of level ROA and cash ROA) — differing only by substituting the TS_MIN for the level inside the MIN, which is a cosmetic variant rather than a new mechanism.

It reassembles the net-liquidity leg of "Liquidity-Backed Intangible Productivity" with the mean-minus-volatility profitability construction of "Net-Cash Profit Reliability" (which already delivered a weak fmb_tstat of 1.38), the only genuine change being the addition of xint to the numerator — too small a modification to constitute a distinct test.

The range-normalized profitability position is a genuinely new state variable (not just the peak-drawdown gap used in "Profitability-Drawdown Earnings Value") and the double-hurdle MIN is internally consistent with the stated hypothesis, though the (TS_MAX − TS_MIN) denominator can be near-zero for stable firms and the mixed RANK/IND_RANK scaling is sloppy.

The architecture (oancf-yield × IND_RANK of a three-year TS_MIN profitability floor) is exactly that of the archived "Cash-Value Intangible Return Floor," with the only change being swapping the intangible-adjusted return for a fixed-charge surplus already used in "Improving Fixed-Charge Surplus Value" — a two-ingredient permutation within a saturated design space.

The profitability leg is copied verbatim from "Liquidity-Backed Intangible Productivity" and the valuation leg verbatim from "Enterprise Cash Conversion Value," so despite a defensible ablation motive (isolating whether cash holdings or cheapness drives the prior result) this remains a leg swap between two archived signals rather than a substantively new construction.

The debt-change-to-market-cap leg is both a close proxy for the well-documented net-debt-issuance/external-financing anomaly and already tested in "Profit-Funded Debt Retirement Yield" (weak: fmb 2.14, ls_talpha 1.40), and the only change here is replacing the dual level-profitability screen with an archived TS_MIN floor.
